title: A Romantic Honeymoon Safari and Zanzibar Retreat
summary: Embark on an enchanting 12-day honeymoon that combines a luxury safari across Tanzania's famed parks with a serene beach retreat in the exotic Zanzibar, creating the perfect blend of adventure and relaxation for newlyweds.
description: Embark on a captivating 12-day honeymoon journey through the unparalleled landscapes of Tanzania. Immerse yourself in thrilling safaris across the country's most iconic national parks, where you’ll encounter Africa's famed wildlife. Afterward, indulge in the serene beauty of Zanzibar's pristine beaches. This journey offers an exquisite blend of romance, adventure, and relaxation, creating memories to cherish for a lifetime.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
itinerary.description: Arrive in Arusha and meet your representative and driver guide at the airport. Transfer to the luxurious Gran Meliá for a relaxing evening, enjoying views of Mount Meru and Mount Kilimanjaro, if weather permits. Optional activities like Lake Duluti canoeing, yoga classes, and city tours are available (additional cost).
itinerary.destination_note: Arusha is known as the safari capital of Tanzania's Northern Safari Circuit.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park
itinerary.description: After a well deserved breakfast, your safari begins at Tarangire National Park, famed for its vast herds of elephants and distinctive baobab trees. Explore the diverse landscapes, home to giraffes, hippos, big cats, and more. In the afternoon you guide will transport you to Escarpment Luxury Lodge, where honeymoon surprises await.
itinerary.destination_note: Tarangire National Park Famous for its large elephant herds

itinerary.title: Serengeti via Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.description: As you traverse the Ngorongoro Highlands, take the opportunity to visit a traditional Maasai Boma, gaining complimentary insights into the rich Maasai culture. From there, your safari continues into the Serengeti National Park, reaching the central Seronera region. This area, nourished by the Seronera River, stands as one of the park's most biodiverse wildlife habitats, providing a constant water source for its vibrant ecosystem. It remains a premier wildlife viewing location throughout the year, where you can encounter elephants, giraffes, impalas, waterbucks, hippos, reedbucks, buffalo, and baboons, even after the wildebeest migration. End your day with dinner and an overnight stay at the Four Seasons Luxury Lodge.
itinerary.destination_note: Serengeti National Park is a World Heritage Site teeming with wildlife

itinerary.title: Serengeti Balloon Safari
itinerary.description: Rise early for an unforgettable balloon safari, where you'll be picked up from your lodge at 5:00 a.m. and gently lifted into the sky by 6:00 a.m. to witness the wildlife of the Serengeti from above. Soar gracefully over the plains, marveling at the animals below before landing to celebrate with a sumptuous breakfast and champagne. Your guide will then meet you for a comprehensive game drive through the heart of the Serengeti, a world-renowned wildlife sanctuary rich in biodiversity. Spot the "Big Five" — elephants, lions, buffalo, leopards, and black rhinos — and over 500 bird species, including vultures, owls, bustards, cranes, and secretary birds.
itinerary.destination_note: Serengeti National Park Including Romantic Balloon Safari

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Highlands
itinerary.description: After enjoying a delectable breakfast, embark on another exhilarating game drive through the Serengeti, exploring its rich landscapes and diverse wildlife. As the day progresses, journey towards the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, where you'll be greeted by breathtaking views at the crater’s rim. Here, catch your first glimpse of the shimmering streams, open grasslands, and countless animals that await you the following day.
itinerary.accommodation: Ngorongoro Lodge member of Meliá Collection
itinerary.destination_note: Serengeti National Park is a World Heritage Site teeming with wildlife

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast, descend into the famed Ngorongoro Crater for a captivating game drive. Formed approximately 2.5 million years ago by the dramatic collapse of a massive volcano, the crater is now a vast, unbroken caldera teeming with wildlife. Its unique ecosystem supports over 25,000 resident animals. Visit Lake Magadi, a distinctive, shallow alkaline lake nestled in the southwestern corner, where flocks of flamingos, hippos, and other water birds thrive. Search for the "Big Five" in this pristine environment before returning to Arusha for an overnight stay, carrying memories of a truly romantic and exciting day.
itinerary.destination_note: Ngorongoro Crater The world's biggest intact volcanic caldera, the Ngorongoro Crater, is located in Tanzania-Ngorongoro near Serengeti national park.

itinerary.title: Arusha - Fly to Zanzibar
itinerary.description: Begin your day with a leisurely breakfast at your accommodation, followed by a transfer to Arusha Airport for your flight to Zanzibar. Upon arrival at Zanzibar Airport, you will be escorted to your hotel. The remainder of the day is yours to enjoy at the beach at your leisure.
itinerary.destination_note: Zanzibar is a Tanzanian archipelago off the coast of East Africa

itinerary.title: Zanzibar
itinerary.description:
Zanzibar is renowned for its world-class beaches, offering ample opportunities to relax, swim, sunbathe, and stroll along the pristine shores. Take in the island’s vibrant atmosphere and immerse yourself in its diverse cultural heritage, particularly in Stone Town, where African, Arab, Indian, and European influences intertwine. Wander through historic landmarks like the former slave market, the Anglican cathedral, and the House of Wonders, and savor the blend of history and architectural beauty.
The island is also famous for its spice plantations, where you can discover the rich flavors and medicinal uses of cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla, cardamom, tamarind, and other aromatic spices. Dive into local markets to taste the freshest seafood and connect with the island's culinary traditions. For those seeking more adventure, optional excursions include a tour of Prison Island, Nakupenda Sandbank, Mnemba Island for dolphin sightings and snorkeling, Jozani Forest, and the Safari Blue experience (additional charges apply based on the activity).
itinerary.destination_note: Zanzibar, Why not visit the historic Prison Island, a small island inhabited by giant tortoises.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar Departure Day
itinerary.description:
Zanzibar is known for its world-class beaches. Today, take the opportunity to relax, swim, sunbathe, or stroll along the coastline before your transfer to the airport for your journey home. This will conclude your memorable wildlife and beach safari with Mazingira. You can choose to fly directly from Zanzibar or via Dar es Salaam.
(Please note that opting to depart from Dar es Salaam will incur additional transportation costs, either by boat or flight, from Zanzibar.)
itinerary.destination_note: Zanzibar last half day before heading home.
